notes.title: About Scenarios 7, 8, 9
notes.notes: The three scenes occurred in the past 1 to 5 years. The first 11 cases in the scene were found by the police up to now. The contents in the newspaper were the number of police discoveries at that time. The red number flashed across the screen was the number of real occurrences at that time. The content scattered in level 8 is Kevin's childhood diary.

notes.title: About the first scenario
notes.notes: At the beginning of the first floor, there will be a steel wall pushing slowly toward you. At this point, you can push it (but it doesn't work), or stay away from it, but don't stand still (if you stand at the door, when I don't say it), because the wall will "swallow" you, and then you can't continue the game. I hope you will notice.  Correct. I may fix this bug in the future, but only possibly. Handmade funny.
